conservative_outer_skirt_generation.design: Add opaque OUTER skirt panels over every formerly white clothing region; close slits; same-or-greater coverage, no white-to-skin changes.
conservative_outer_skirt_generation.representative_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Revise this adult female game character's clothing to be MORE COVERED by ADDING AN OUTER SKIRT PANEL. Keep this exact pose, body silhouette, leg positions, head, face, hair, hands, white upper blouse and shoes identical. Add natural pleated opaque red OUTER-SKIRT fabric over the ENTIRE visible white athletic-shorts/underlayer area at her hips. Every area currently covered by white cloth must remain covered by opaque red outer-skirt fabric, not skin. Retain all hidden underlying garments in place. The red cloth must fully bridge and cover the middle between the upper legs and both side/rear openings, with complete modest coverage. Make these skirt slits smaller so the area of exposed skin is the SAME OR LESS than the original, never more. Preserve the existing short outer-skirt hem length, but add overlapping side/back panels matching it; no trousers legs, no shorts seams. Treat it as additional draped cloth over the existing outfit, not undressing or removing any coverage. The red panels need believable fold shadows and darker red shaded back surfaces, with the same hand-drawn anime game-art linework and original red palette. Surgical garment-only edit. Everything outside the hip/outer-skirt area remains identical. Same canvas and character placement, transparent background, no labels or new objects.

IMAGE 2 shows the NEW APPROVED MORE-COVERED OUTER-SKIRT DESIGN. Apply that conservative added-cloth design to all six adult-character frames of image 1. Keep image 1's exact canvas, frame layout, scale, faces, hair, body proportions, every arm/leg pose, shoes and white blouse unchanged. ADD opaque pleated red OUTER SKIRT PANELS over the ENTIRE white athletic-underlayer area. EVERY pixel region that currently shows white hip/shorts fabric must remain covered by RED outer skirt cloth, NEVER skin; keep hidden underlying garments in place. Narrow/close the side slits. Add complete red outer-skirt overlap across the middle between upper legs and the side/back areas, with natural folds as shown in image 2. This is ADDITION of modest outer clothing, with same-or-greater coverage throughout. Do not increase bare skin, do not remove coverage, do not retain shorts-shaped leg openings. Match the current short overall skirt hem length and original red cloth style while adding side/back panel width to fully conceal the white underlayer. Darker red underside folds should remain opaque. Surgical garment edit only, no other redraw. Original transparent background. No labels, no new items.
